summary: B4 complete: scene import, pool, preferences, commands and final-quality exports implemented; VM gates and wasm check passed.
body:
**Files changed**

- `crates/engine/Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock` (one dependency entry).
- Engine sources: `lib.rs`, `commands.rs`, `media_pool.rs`, `settings.rs`, `export_tools.rs`, `keyboard.rs`, `aaf_omf.rs`, `project_manager.rs`, `proxies.rs`.
- New engine sources: `scene_render.rs`, `scene_render_tests.rs`.
- `crates/media/src/lib.rs`, `docs/control-protocol.md`.

**Public API added**

```rust
MediaPool::set_scene_env(
    &self,
    config: filmcraft_scenerender::Config,
    cache_dir: Option<std::path::PathBuf>,
    quality: filmcraft_scenerender::Quality,
) -> bool
MediaPool::clear_scenes(&self)
PoolProvider::final_scenes(self) -> Self
```

`PluginPrefs` adds `scene_render_path: String` and `scene_render_preview_quality: String`, defaulting to empty and `"preview"`.

Commands: `scene.renderer.status {}` → `{found, path, version, schema, reason}`; `scene.renderer.clearCache {}` → `{bytes}`.

**Design notes**

Scene import preserves `MediaRef::File`, header metadata and renderer warnings with either host I/O mode. Reader sizes are checked against the parser’s 64 MiB limit. Native relative paths become absolute; wasm opening returns `Unsupported`.

Preview and final scene sources have separate caches. Renderer, quality and cache-location changes invalidate scene sources and their proxies, then bump the view. Other media sources remain cached.

Final quality covers ordinary/quick/queued exports, still-frame export, AAF video mixdown, consolidation and permanent transcodes. Playback, render previews and proxy generation retain preview quality. Placeholder exports use existing `offlineMedia` reporting; consolidation/transcoding reject offline inputs.

A missing explicit executable falls through to environment/PATH discovery. Tests therefore use an existing non-executable file to force deterministic placeholder mode.

**TDD red → green log**

All names below are in `scene_render_tests`.

| Test | Observed red failure |
|---|---|
| `scene_extension_is_importable_and_in_dialog_filters` | `is_importable("clip.SCENE")` was false |
| `scene_old_preferences_load_defaults_and_rows_validate` | Missing path field: `Null != ""` |
| `scene_renderer_commands_and_hostile_parameters` | `UnknownCommand("scene.renderer.status")` |
| `scene_import_placeholder_with_reader` | Import returned `unrecognised format` |
| `scene_import_placeholder_without_reader` | Import returned `unrecognised format` |
| `scene_stage2_pool_pref_change_invalidates_only_scenes_and_proxies` | “scene source must reopen for new quality” |
| `scene_stage2_cache_clear_and_cache_location_reopen_sources` | “clearCache must drop in-memory frames” |
| `scene_stage2_export_media_uses_final_while_playback_and_previews_use_preview` | Renderer log contained only `--quality preview` |
| `scene_stage2_export_queue_uses_final` | “queue must render final frames” |
| `scene_stage2_export_frame_uses_final` | “still export must render final frames” |
| `scene_stage2_export_placeholder_reports_after_pool_reopen` | `offlineMedia` was empty |
| `scene_stage3_aaf_mixdown_uses_final_and_reports_placeholders` | “AAF mixdown must render final frames” |
| `scene_stage3_consolidation_uses_final` | “consolidated media must render final frames” |
| `scene_stage3_transcode_uses_final` | “transcoded media must render final frames” |

All subsequently passed. Two intermediate runs exposed fixture mistakes; the fixture was corrected to use a versioned `<scene>` root before the cache/export red assertions were evaluated. Startup preference loading and oversized-reader rejection add two passing regression tests: **16 scene tests total**.

**Final VM results**

- Required combined command passed: clippy `--all-targets -- -D warnings`, engine tests, and `cargo xtask layers`.
- Engine tests: **649 passed, 0 failed, 3 ignored**; doc tests: 0.
- `cargo check -p filmcraft-engine --target wasm32-unknown-unknown`: passed.
- Changed Rust files formatted; `git diff --check` clean.

Ready for integration. No commits or pushes. `crates/scenerender` remains untouched; no out-of-scope edits are required.
